summary: Wolfspeed disclosed unaudited pro forma financial information giving effect to its prepackaged plan of reorganization (Chapter 11), effective September 29, 2025, fresh-start accounting, and regulatory approvals received on January 29, 2026. The filing provides pro forma statements of operations for the year ended June 29, 2025 and nine months ended March 29, 2026. No per-share price or premium was stated. This is a post-emergence financial update, not a new restructuring event. Watch for further operational milestones as the reorganized company executes its turnaround plan.
